review.notes: Full review. Gate fails on readme-ids-missing only (six supplier names read as own, R02); build clean (57 sorries), depcheck 0 problems. All 15 sampled subsections read against DLMF 16.13-16.16 (Release 1.2.8): every formula agrees. All 57 Lean statements and the README checks recomputed with mpmath, including regularized forms at seven pole parameter sets and principal branches far from the origin: all hold. One P2: the fibre bound in the 5.3 proof sketch is false (|y|^-m should be (sqrt|y|-1)^-2m); the target is unaffected. Seven P3: gate, locator for the G2/G3 systems, Checks for G2/G3, Needs lines, unstated coefficient identities with certificate wording, one padding theorem, two missing docstrings. Erdelyi et al. and Burchnall-Chaundy could not be read.
